employees.basis: employees eligible to be granted awards from the 2019 Plan (total employees, including 8 executive officers)

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), proposal to amend the 2019 Equity Incentive Plan, Eligibility
source.quote: As of January 26, 2026, we had a total of 31,375 employees, including 8 executive officers, and 10 non-employee directors and 5 consultants, who would be eligible to be granted awards from the 2019 Plan.

payroll.label: annual total compensation of our median compensated employee

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The fiscal year 2025 annual total compensation of our CEO was $51,173,935 and the annual total compensation of our median compensated employee was $235,989

notes: Employees: the FY2025 10-K's human capital section states no head count, so the count is the proxy's total of 31,375 employees at January 26, 2026, about two months after the November 28, 2025 year end. Payroll: the 10-K gives no total of salaries and benefits, so the CEO pay ratio disclosure's fiscal 2025 median employee pay is used.
